do_not_apply: Do not modify user custom exercises

contribution_model.1.0: Primary hypertrophy target. One working set = one equivalent set for that muscle.
contribution_model.0.5: Meaningful secondary hypertrophy stimulus. One working set = half an equivalent set.
contribution_model.0.25: Reserved. Not used by SCIENCE_RULES_V1. Do not invent for this pass.
contribution_model.0: No hypertrophy credit: stabilizer, warmup, mobility, stretch, hang, cardio, olympic/power practice.

precedence.rule: The 260 enriched masters must not depend on name inference for normal operation. Stop merging NAME_DEFAULTS into explicit credits once the 260 are complete. Name inference remains a safety net for incomplete/legacy/custom rows only.

naive_audit_vs_authoritative_proposal.naive_rejected_reason: Pattern-only overlay treated every vertical_push as an overhead press (Dip → front_delts 1.0) and every hinge as a hamstring deadlift. That is not the contribution model.
leave_unchanged_examples: Low Row stays lats 1.0 + upper_back 0.5 + biceps 0.5 (lat-biased elbow path)
Meadows Row stays lats 1.0 + upper_back 0.5 + biceps 0.5 (lat-stretch row)
Straight-Arm Pulldown stays lats-only after removing erroneous biceps 0.5; no upper_back

rules.reason: Vertical pulls are lat-primary. Scapular depressors / mid-back get meaningful but not equal stimulus. Catalog already lists upper_back as secondary; stored credits omit it. conservativeCredits() only adds biceps for vertical_pull.

Free-weight / chest-supported horizontal rows are scapular-retraction upper-back primaries. Enrichment EXACT overrides and inferPrimaryFallback currently force lats 1.0 + upper_back 0.5. Do not also give lats 1.0.
These rows already credit upper_back 1.0 correctly. They omit lats 0.5 even though catalog secondary_muscles include lats. Add the missing secondary only.
Elbows-tucked / stretch-biased rows stay lat-primary. This is the exercise-specific exception so not every row becomes upper_back 1.0.

Rear-delt / scapular work is rear_delts-primary with meaningful upper_back secondary. Enrichment tagged them horizontal_pull and auto-added biceps 0.5. Do not convert them into generic rows (upper_back 1 + lats 0.5).
Shoulder-extension lat isolation. No scapular retraction, no elbow flexion. Stored biceps 0.5 is an enrichment artifact from vertical_pull + biceps default.
Working or commonly prescribed scapular drills with empty stored credits currently fall through to 0.5/0.5 secondaries or zero if treated as warmup.
